**United Kingdom: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,851,793 applications. The latest year, 2025, was the recorded peak, with 168,185 applications. Applications in 2025 were 211% higher than in 2019 (54,072). In 2025, 194,877 recorded decisions equated to 116 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 51% higher than in 2024 (111,107). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 3 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Unknown (64,052), Pakistan (10,951), Eritrea (9,107).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 40%, across 156,735 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 20% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 7.6 percentage points lower than in 2024 (47%).
